# Split Slices

**Motion › Split** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (12–60)

The old scene breaks into horizontal slices that slide off alternately left and right, showing the new scene behind.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/split-slices@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Tech and sports edits
- Energetic section changes
- Title sequences

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import splitSlices from './transitions/05-motion/split/split-slices';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(splitSlices, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slices` | integer | `7` | 2–24 | Number of slices. |
| `orientation` | enum | `"horizontal"` | `horizontal` · `vertical` | Slice direction. |
| `stagger` | number | `0.35` | 0–0.8 | How much the slices move one after another. |
